//: The schema, the journal and the migration runner. Depends on drizzle-orm, pg and zod and on nothing inside this repo — that is the property the package exists to hold, and `src/json.ts`, `src/entity-refs.ts` and the two schema files that declare their own column payload types are where the four former `#/lib/...` imports ended up (SPA-142).
name: @spaces/db
//exports: Source entry points, not a build output: every consumer is bundled by vite or loaded by tsx/vitest, all of which resolve TypeScript through `exports`. The five shapes are the ones SPA-135's import sweep wrote into apps/web — `@spaces/db`, `@spaces/db/schema`, `@spaces/db/schema/<name>`, `@spaces/db/entity-refs`, `@spaces/db/heartbeat` — plus `./migrate` and `./json` from SPA-142 and `./test-db` from SPA-143, which is the vitest harness and is imported by no shipping code.
//bin: Migrations only — guard, then `migrate()`, then exit. The boot composition that also seeds is apps/web's (`apps/web/src/db/boot.ts`), and moves to core at mono-9a.
